title: Full review follow-ups: cleanup items not yet confirmed fixed
description:
The 2026-10-17 full review (/reviews/2026-10-17-full-review/ in project files) top six findings are fixed on develop: user routes bound to the signed-in user, customer cross-account role bounded, computer record uses conditional writes, worker registration secured, turn stream reconnects and token storage fixed with a report-only CSP, and the acceptance smoke test now runs after development and staging deploys.

Not confirmed either way (check each against develop before working): README is a ~700-line changelog; stray features/computer_owner_credential_renewal.feature-e containing a conflict marker; develop package.json version lags main releases; Kanbus board commits are about half of develop history; report-only CSP has not been promoted to enforcing; infra findings exist only in the Claude Doc 'Chatticus full review' (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/37d2f3b8-a89b-47ba-8013-989badfc68ff). Lower-priority findings in the three findings files are untriaged.
